title: SUPPLY PROGRAM MANAGER
description:

**Responsibilities**

* Prepare RFQs, conduct supplier consultations and negotiations, manage sourcing decisions, and ensure follow\-up after supplier nomination.

**Requirements**
* Mechanical or Plastics engineering background.
* 8–10 years of experience in New Product Development and Supplier Management.

title: CTRM - RightAngle | Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic**
 Our Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level:** 
 Manager or equivalent
   

  

 As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead cross\-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Our Enterprise \& Operations Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market\-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
   

  

 We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team
   

  

* Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.
* Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.
* Drive enterprise\- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.


**The team:**
 Our Commodity Trading \& Risk Management advisory practice solves our clients’ most complex issues and helps drive transformative changes to their supply, trading, and marketing organizations. We support our clients with advice related to physical and financial commodity market challenges through commercial \& risk advisory, quantitative analysis, technology and operational advisory services.
   

  

 Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. These services are organized into three capability areas \- Strategic Services, Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services, and Technology Services:
   

  

* Strategic Services help clients define fit\-for\-purpose operating models for their commodities, define the changes required to realize that vision, and develop a roadmap for execution
* Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services assess the existing compliance, risk, and operational processes of our clients leveraging proprietary tools to yield insights for improvement or optimization
* Technology Services deliver custom and package technology solutions that help our clients manage their commodity business and associated risk \& compliance exposures.
* Managers are responsible for setting goals that align with organizational objectives
* As a manager will focus on the management and delivery of client engagements, as well as sales and practice development.
* Managing multiple project budget, monitoring expenditure and costs as the project progresses.
* Facilitating the appointment of individuals to project teams.
* Provide deep subject matter expertise on CTRM Projects.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
**Functional Requirements –**
* 10 – 15 years of experience in business processes across Trading and Contract management, Physical Commodity Trading and their related financial derivatives, Scheduling, Mark to Market, Vars, Write on/Write offs, Inventory Management, Invoicing and Accounting.
* Familiarity with Pricing tools such as ZEMA
* Understanding of deal pricing and pricing strategies
* Understand End of day and End of Month processes for the month close. Understanding of the RA month close process and sequence of jobs to be run to facilitate month end.
* Familiarity with Right Angle Risk Management module. Understand hedging strategies and managed or supported Hedge/offset deals in Right Angle.
* Understanding of snapshots – intraday, end of day, weekly and monthly processes.


**Technical Requirements –**
* Good skills on SQL and .Net
* Have worked on or previously supported integration of Right Angle with other applications using.net class dll and WCF services.
* Leverage AzureDev Ops or similar deployment workflow for RA development and deployments
* Have worked on or have supported Right Angle version upgrades.
* Familiar with deployment of RightAngle enhancements and customizations.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies
* Worked on RightAngle version 15 or above.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university.
* MBA or related PG preferred


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Manager Installation, Erection & commissioning
description:
SMRT(i)PL, we have Rock Processing business area, which is a leading supplier in equipment, services, support and technical solutions for construction and mining industry and specialist in Crushing, Screening, Mobile plants, and attachments
   

  

 We are looking for a dynamic and an energetic Manager Installation, Erection \& commissioning, this role will be based at Pune.
   

  

**Required Experience\- 10\-12 Years, Qualification\- B.E.**
**Job Synopsis:**
 The Installation, Erection \& Commissioning Team is expected to deliver the supplied Crushing and Screening Plants/Equipment as per the OEM drawings supplied by design and complete successful installation, erection, commissioning, testing, and handover of crushing and screening plants at customer sites. The role ensures compliance with safety, quality, project timelines, and customer requirements while providing technical support during commissioning and stabilization of plant operations. With this Sandvik is looking to grow the Plant and Solutions Business to next level and provide exceptional services in terms of plant deliveries
   

  

**Installation \& Erection**
* Supervise installation and erection activities of crushing, screening, washing, conveying, and material han
* Conduct pre\-commissioning inspections and readiness checks.
* Execute no\-load and load trials of crushing and screening plants.
* Commission electrical systems, motors, drives, PLCs, MCCs, instrumentation, and safety interlocks.
* Optimize plant performance to achieve design capacity, product quality, and operational efficiency.
* Identify and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and process\-related issues during commissioning.
* Ensure successful performance testing and plant handover to customers.


**Project Coordination**
* Coordinate with project managers, design engineers, procurement teams, vendors, and customers.
* Ensure availability of tools, manpower, and site resources.
* Support project planning, scheduling, and milestone tracking.
* Monitor work progress against project timelines and escalate risks proactively.


**Quality \& Safety**
* Ensure compliance with company HSE policies and customer safety regulations.
* Conduct toolbox talks and safety briefings at project sites.
* Verify adherence to installation quality standards and commissioning procedures.
* Ensure all work permits and safety documentation are maintained.


**Documentation \& Reporting**
* Prepare installation and commissioning reports.
* Maintain punch point lists and closure reports.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Prepare handover documents, equipment checklists, and customer acceptance certificates.
* Record lessons learned and provide feedback to engineering teams.


**Customer Support**
* Provide operator and maintenance staff training during project handover.
* Support customers during plant stabilization period.
* Attend breakdowns and resolve technical issues during warranty periods.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high customer satisfaction.


**What We Offer**
 Sandvik offers a competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits. In addition, we provide opportunities for professional competence development and training, as well as opportunities for career advancement.
   

  

**Our culture**
 At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to your application and ask you to send it no later than 30th September 2026\.
   

  

**Contact Information**
 For further information about this position, please contact:
   

  

 Avantika Iyer, Recruitment Specialist

description:

* Partner with Communications, HR, and business stakeholders to strengthen Cummins' employer value proposition.
* Manage employer brand presence across digital platforms, universities, and professional networks.
* Develop engaging content and campaigns to enhance awareness of Cummins as an employer of choice.


 Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Acquisition processes.

* Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR leaders to promote inclusive hiring practices.
* Monitor hiring trends and recommend initiatives that strengthen workforce representation.


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Develop and maintain talent acquisition dashboards, reports, and insights.
* Analyze recruiting trends, labor market data, and talent metrics to support business decisions.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations to Talent Acquisition and business leaders.
* Support workforce planning, forecasting, and executive reporting activities.


 Stakeholder \& Project Management
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional projects and Talent Acquisition initiatives.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, Communications, Technology, and business leaders.
* Coordinate regional and global programs that support Talent Acquisition transformation.
* Drive communication, governance, and knowledge\-sharing across the Talent Acquisition community.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, HR Operations, Process Improvement, HR Technology, or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional projects and change initiatives.
* Experience working with data, analytics, and reporting tools.

**Skills**

* Excellent communication and influencing skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Experience driving process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Curiosity and passion for emerging technologies, including AI and automation.
* Ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed, and global environment.


 Why Join Cummins?

You'll work at the intersection of people, technology, and innovation while helping shape the future of Talent Acquisition through transformative initiatives that create meaningful business impact.

 Data Analytics \- Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
   

  

 Human Resources Consulting \- Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.
   

  

 Human Resources Business Process Execution \- Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Interpersonal savvy \- Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Demonstrates self\-awareness \- Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.
   

  

 Situational adaptability \- Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.
   

  

 Tech savvy \- Anticipating and adopting innovations in business\-building digital and technology applications.
   

  

 Education, Licenses, Certifications: Professional certifications in project management, HR management, or directly related to the 30% or equivalent experience are preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Good depth of experience in project support or management, preferably within a Talent Acquisition or HR function, demonstrating a capability in managing projects or components within larger programs.
   

  

 Good to have 12\+ years into the same domain.
   

  

 This role operates across the India and Pacific region, partnering with global Talent Acquisition, HR Technology, Communications, and business leaders to drive strategic talent initiatives. The position is responsible for adapting global programs to regional needs, leading cross\-country projects, influencing diverse stakeholder groups, and identifying innovative practices that enhance employer brand, recruiting effectiveness, technology adoption, and candidate experience across multiple markets and cultures.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME**

title: Deployment Project Manager
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Deployment Project Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring the successful deployment of Litmus products into our customer’s environments.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will create and manage implementation schedules, manage issues and risks and develop and execute project communication strategies for our client\-facing projects.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will also, at times, have oversight of third\-party partners who will be performing work as sub\-contractors to Litmus.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Manages Litmus projects using a waterfall methodology through Initiation, Planning, Execution and Close Phases
* Develop and maintain schedules, manage issues and risks for customer facing deployments of Litmus products
* Manage scope of the project and identify / issue change requests due to changing requirements
* Prepare project management reports for Account Management and customer stakeholders
* Develop statement of work in conjunction with sales and account management teams, including estimates for project effort
* Perform cost analysis for ongoing projects and recommend actions to preserve profit margin as needed
* Hold project status meetings, take and publish minutes, ensure timely communication with customers
* Leads handover to support of any deployment projects as part of the Closedown phase


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* Proven track record and experience implementing software and infrastructure projects in a manufacturing environment
* Excellent communication, negotiation and organizational skills
* Experience using Wrike or other Project Management software
* Experience performing in a customer facing / interactive role
* Self\-starter and able to work independently as well as in a team environment


**Nice to Have**
* PMP or other professional project manager designation is preferred
* Background in manufacturing software or infrastructure is an asset
* Enjoys solving problems
* Enjoys staying up to date on new technology and continually learning new things
* Able to adapt to change in a fast\-paced environment.

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

 We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA PP / QM Lead to lead Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) workstreams in large\-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation projects. The role is responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of manufacturing and quality solution design, delivery governance, and successful adoption of SAP S/4HANA best practices.
   

  

 The PP / QM Lead will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, and cross\-functional SAP teams to drive transformation across Plan\-to\-Produce and Quality\-to\-Release processes.

 :
   

  

**S/4HANA PP / QM Workstream Leadership**
* Lead PP and QM workstreams in SAP S/4HANA transformation programs (Greenfield, Brownfield, or Selective Data Transition).
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of Plan\-to\-Produce, Production Execution, and Quality processes.
* Act as the primary escalation point for PP / QM\-related topics.


**Solution Design \& Delivery**
* Drive solution design and hands\-on configuration for:
* SAP PP: Demand Management, MRP, BOMs, Routings, Work Centers, Capacity Planning, Production Orders
* SAP QM: Inspection Planning, Inspection Types, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications
* Ensure adoption of S/4HANA manufacturing and quality simplifications and innovations.
* Guide decisions on Discrete vs Process Manufacturing scenarios.


**S/4HANA Transformation Activities**
* Lead Fit\-to\-Standard (F2S) workshops and business process harmonization.
* Assess and manage custom code (RICEFW) impacts for PP / QM in S/4HANA.
* Lead manufacturing and quality master data conversion and validation activities.


**Integration \& Cross\-Module Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with MM, WM/EWM, SD, PM, and FI/CO teams.
* Ensure seamless integration across Procure\-to\-Produce and Make\-to\-Deliver processes.
* Collaborate with technical teams (ABAP, CPI, interfaces) on enhancements and integrations.


**Testing, Cutover \& Go\-Live**
* Lead unit testing, SIT, UAT, and defect resolution for PP / QM.
* Own cutover planning for production orders, batches, and inspection lots.
* Provide go\-live and hypercare support, ensuring manufacturing stability.


**Governance \& Team Leadership**
* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate methodology, project standards, and documentation.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, and test artifacts.
* Mentor PP / QM consultants and support knowledge transfer.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

* Experience with:
* S/4HANA MRP and production execution simplifications
* QM integration with MM and PP
* Batch Management, Serial Numbers, and Inspection Lot Processing
* Exposure to Advanced Planning (PP/DS, IBP) is an advantage.
* Knowledge on LeanIX, Signavio for process flow preparation and discussion with business team, is an added advantage.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

title: Lead, Business Continuity Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**
**Location**
 Bangalore / Pune
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).
   

  

 This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.


**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**
* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.


**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.


**Operational Resilience**
* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.


**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**
* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.
* Partner with:
+ Infrastructure Engineering
+ Cyber Security
+ IT Operations
+ Technology Risk Management
+ Enterprise Risk
+ Corporate Services
+ Business Units

* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**
* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)
* ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* PMP
* ITIL


**Experience**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Business Continuity Management, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, Technology Risk, or Technology Operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years managing continuity programs within a technology organization.
* Experience supporting large\-scale global technology environments.
* Experience managing regulatory, audit, and risk management engagements.
* Financial services experience preferred but not mandatory.


**Technical Knowledge**
**Strong Understanding Of**
* Business Continuity Management (BCM)
* Disaster Recovery (DR)


**Leadership Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Communication
* Stakeholder Influence
* Risk\-Based Decision Making
* Program Management
* Problem Solving
* Cross\-Cultural Leadership
* Collaboration Across Global Teams
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Success Measures**
**The Role Will Be Measured By**
* Completion and quality of APAC continuity plans.
* Regulatory and audit outcomes.
* DR testing completion and success rates.
* Reduction in continuity\-related risk exposure.
* Timely closure of resilience remediation activities.
* Executive and regulatory reporting quality.
* Recovery readiness for critical technology services.
* Alignment of APAC resilience practices with global standards.


**Scope of Responsibility**
* Regional ownership of Technology BCM and Operational Resilience for APAC.
* Coordination with global continuity and recovery teams.
* Support for technology operations spanning multiple APAC countries and time zones.
* Influence across infrastructure, application delivery, cyber security, and technology operations teams.
* Participation in executive crisis management and major incident governance.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Cyber Risk Governance & Reporting
description:
Join us as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Managing a large and complex portfolio of cyber risk governance, regulatory assurance, and reporting activities across regions, entities, and stakeholders
* Performing data analysis and preparing responses to support Barclays’ continued compliance with regulatory obligations across the globe
* Strong working knowledge of cyber security, risk management, and regulatory expectations, with the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, non\-technical outputs for senior stakeholders and regulators
* Using collaboration, workflow, and reporting platforms such as SharePoint, trackers, and MI dashboards to generate insights, support decision\-making, monitor delivery, and highlight emerging risks
* Supporting tracking, oversight, and resolution of control issues, including those raised by 2LOD and internal assessments that could impact regulatory compliance
* Driving group\-wide GRC assessments, reporting, and compliance to the Barclays Control Framework to identify control enhancements aligned to regulatory requirements
* Enabling proactive risk identification through thematic analysis, MI\-driven insights, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective stakeholder engagement


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong experience in Governance, Risk \& Control within large enterprises, preferably within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
* Ability to generate, analyse, and interpret cyber security MI using qualitative and quantitative techniques to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Experience with audit oversight, control frameworks, internal assessment activities, and regulatory requirements, including the ability to support evidence\-based assurance and issue remediation
* Ability to translate technical cyber risks into business\-relevant insights, reporting narratives, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cyber, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and senior leadership teams.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, and communication, as well as job\-specific technical skills in cyber risk governance, regulatory engagement, reporting, and quality assurance.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision\-making process of business challenges and opportunities.
* Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.
* Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.
* Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post\-transaction integration.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.
* Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: SAP Platform Lead
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 6 September 2024
 



**Department:** 
 Program Optimus
 



**Location:** 
 India
   

  




**Description**
*Great People Work Here*
 Transforming WHAT we do and HOW we do it.
   

  

 We are embarking on a huge program of global business transformation enabled by the implementation of a new global technology solution. The delivery and embedding of this technology solution across our highly successful and highly de\-centralized business will change the way we work forever, enabling greater data insight, simplification of processes and ways of working and creating greater collaboration across the business.
   

  

**Purpose:** 
 The Platform Leader is accountable for delivering the strategic technical design, implementation, and long\-term vision for applications and integrations under the Optimus program. This role involves strategic leadership, working closely with key stakeholders to align platform initiatives with business goals, ensuring that the technology landscape supports current needs while also preparing for future growth and innovation. In partnership with our SI partner, AMS Partner, SAP, and the business technology services (BTS) architecture team, this role oversees planning and delivery across Basis, Infrastructure, Security, technical development, integrations, and overall technical architecture of our global SAP solution. The role demands a blend of strategic thinking, hands\-on leadership, problem\-solving, and good relationship management.
   

  

**Scope:** 
 This is a global role covering TwiningsOvo (TwO) international businesses. The role will require occasional international travel.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide strategic leadership in the implementation of platforms and applications under the Optimus program, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and long\-term strategy.
* Oversee the development and execution of the platform and integration strategy, ensuring that platforms are secure by design, scalable, and able to support the future growth of the business.
* Respond strategically to new and emerging security threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring proactive rather than reactive responses.
* Develop and implement policies for managing applications and platforms securely, including identity and access management, patching, and disaster recovery, with a focus on future\-proofing the technology landscape.
* * * Provide the strategic implementation of iPaaS platforms that deliver any\-to\-any integration across heterogeneous applications in hybrid landscapes worldwide.
* Foster innovation and strategic thinking in the development and building of a centralized, well\-documented API estate, promoting reuse and supporting API versioning and lifecycle management.
* Shape the current and target state of application and integration architectures, defining and managing strategic standards, guidelines, and processes to govern integration and future expansion.
* Ensure the seamless transition from the program to BAU of all platforms, applications, and integrations, establishing comprehensive strategic processes and comprehensive documentation to support long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate strategically with AMS teams to analyze operations and develop cost\-effective strategies to reduce manual tasks and improve the overall health and performance of underlying platforms.
* Stay ahead of technology trends and explore the strategic application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models.
* Develop strategic partnerships with other leaders to implement new platforms, develop custom solutions, and modernize integrations to support the company’s strategic direction.
* Maintain and develop strategic relationships with key technology suppliers, ensuring that their roadmaps align with our long\-term strategic goals.
* Manage financial budgets strategically, ensuring that investments are aligned with the long\-term health and strategic direction of the platforms and applications.
* **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
	+ At least 10 years of hands\-on experience working with SAP technologies in a large\-scale, multi\-platform systems environment.
	+ Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic plans for platform security and emerging security threats.
	+ Expertise in future\-focused SAP tech stack/platforms: i.e., SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud ALM, IAG, Ariba, IBP, etc.
	+ Proven strategic leadership in developing and delivering large\-scale IT projects across multiple geographies and platforms.
	+ Good strategic planning skills with experience in shaping and delivering long\-term technical roadmaps aligned with business goals.
	+ Demonstrated growth in influencing and executing strategic decisions that balance business needs and technical capabilities.
	+ Proven experience in implementing strategic partnerships and maintaining third\-party relationships to support business and technical strategies**Benefits**
	+ Monthly phone bill maximum reimbursement limit is Rs.3000\.
	+ Annual check\-up for employee and spouse including Doctor consultation \- reimbursement up to INR 15,000\.
	+ Medical Insurance 5 lakhs Flat Coverage.
	+ PF and Gratuity.
	+ Long Service Policy.
	+ Life Term Policy,
	+ Monthly Broadband Bill Reimbursement \- Rs.2000 or on actual whichever is lower.

* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.

* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Factory Manager- Aluminium Facades
description:
Production Manager – Aluminium Façades
 



**Company:** 
 McCoy Architectural Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Chakan, Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Aluminium Façades Manufacturing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Plant Head / Factory Manager
 



**Direct reports:** 
 Production Engineers, Supervisors, Operators, Assembly Technicians and Helpers
 



**Functional coordination:** 
 Engineering, PPC, Quality, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, EHS and Site Installation
 



 This role is tailored for an architectural façade manufacturing environment involving aluminium façade systems, skylights and related building\-envelope products.
 



 Job purpose
 



 To plan, manage and control aluminium façade production so that products are manufactured safely, accurately, economically and according to approved drawings, project schedules and quality requirements.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 Production planning and execution
 


* Execute production plans issued by PPC.
* Manage cutting, CNC machining, routing, drilling, assembly and packing activities.
* Ensure correct production sequencing for stick, unitised, semi\-unitised, curtain\-wall and cladding systems.
* Allocate manpower, machines, tools and workstations.
* Monitor daily production against planned quantities and project milestones.
* Coordinate production priorities with Engineering, PPC and Project Management.



 Technical and drawing control
 


* Ensure production uses only approved and revision\-controlled drawings.
* Verify profiles, accessories, glass, brackets, fasteners, gaskets and sealants before production.
* Review fabrication drawings, cutting lists, BOMs and assembly instructions.
* Identify design or constructability issues before production starts.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with the Engineering Department.



 Quality control
 


* Ensure correct profile dimensions, cutting accuracy, drilling positions and assembly tolerances.
* Control joint preparation, corner crimping, screw fixing, sealing and gasket installation.
* Ensure correct use of approved sealants, tapes, fasteners and accessories.
* Coordinate first\-piece inspection and in\-process inspection with QA/QC.
* Reduce rejection, leakage risk, scratches, dents, colour mismatch and rework.
* Support mock\-ups, performance testing and customer inspections.



 Manpower and shop\-floor management
 


* Supervise production supervisors and shift teams.
* Maintain skill matrices and arrange operator training.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, overtime and labour productivity.
* Establish standard work instructions for repetitive operations.
* Promote 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.



 Material and inventory control
 


* Coordinate with Stores for timely availability of aluminium profiles and accessories.
* Control material identification, batch traceability and project\-wise segregation.
* Minimise profile wastage and damage during handling.
* Ensure proper protection of finished components before dispatch.
* Report shortages, excess consumption and material discrepancies.



 Equipment and maintenance
 


* Ensure proper operation of saws, CNC machines, routers, drilling machines, crimping machines and assembly tools.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance with the Maintenance Department.
* Report machine breakdowns and production losses promptly.
* Ensure calibration and condition of measuring instruments and jigs.



 Safety and compliance
 


* Enforce PPE, safe material handling and machine\-guarding requirements.
* Ensure safe use of sealants, solvents, adhesives and cutting equipment.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shop\-floor safety inspections.
* Stop unsafe work and report incidents or near misses.
* Maintain good housekeeping and emergency access routes.



 Dispatch and site coordination
 


* Coordinate packing and dispatch in the required installation sequence.
* Ensure identification marks, labels, packing lists and project documents are complete.
* Support site teams with installation feedback and technical clarification.
* Analyse site complaints and implement corrective actions in production.



 Key performance indicators
 


* Production plan achievement
* On\-time project dispatch
* Labour productivity
* First\-pass quality acceptance
* Rework and rejection percentage
* Aluminium profile utilisation and wastage
* Machine utilisation and downtime
* Material damage during production
* Customer/site complaints
* Safety observations and incidents
* 5S and housekeeping audit score



 Decision\-making authority
 



 The Production Manager may:
 


* Allocate manpower and production resources.
* Re\-sequence work within approved project priorities.
* Hold defective or damaged material for inspection.
* Stop production where drawings, materials or safety conditions are inadequate.
* Recommend overtime, subcontracting or additional manpower.
* Initiate corrective action for recurring production problems.



 Changes to design, specifications, material grades, finishes or approved drawings require Engineering and Quality approval.
 



 Qualification
 


* Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering.
* Additional knowledge of aluminium façade systems, curtain walls, cladding or glazing is preferred.
* Knowledge of CAD drawings, BOMs, production planning and inspection procedures.



 Experience
 


* 8–12 years in aluminium façade, curtain\-wall, cladding, glazing or architectural metal manufacturing.
* Experience supervising a project\-based, customised production environment.
* Experience with aluminium profiles, CNC machining, façade accessories and assembly tolerances.
* Exposure to site installation and façade mock\-up requirements is desirable.



 Required skills
 


* Aluminium façade production knowledge
* Production planning and manpower control
* Drawing and BOM interpretation
* Problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis
* Quality and dimensional\-control awareness
* ERP/MIS reporting
* Vendor and subcontractor coordination
* Team leadership and communication
* Strong safety and housekeeping discipline



 Personal attributes
 


* Hands\-on shop\-floor leadership
* Strong attention to dimensional and finish quality
* Ability to work under project deadlines
* Practical and systematic problem\-solving approach
* Willingness to work in shifts when required
* High ownership for delivery and customer satisfaction

**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**
**Location: Pune / Hybrid**
**Role Purpose**
 As an
 **Critical** 
**Incident Manager (CIM)** 
 , you will lead the end\-to\-end management of business\-critical and high\-visibility production incidents, ensure rapid restoration of services and minimizing customer impact. You will direct incident response activities, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive effective communication strategies throughout the incident lifecycle.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and managing P1/P2 incidents, ensuring timely resolution within SLA commitments, driving structured incident governance, and maintaining alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for incident management, stakeholder communication, operational governance, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement. The focus will be on ensuring operational resilience, maintaining customer trust, improving service reliability, and driving proactive incident prevention initiatives in line with
 **Accelya's global business strategy, values, and mission.**
**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Incident Ownership \& Lifecycle Management**
* Own and manage the lifecycle of critical P1/P2 and high\-priority incidents from detection through resolution and closure.
* Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, ensuring timely engagement of appropriate stakeholders and technical teams.
* Perform impact assessments, severity classification, and incident prioritization to ensure effective response execution.
* Drive production fixes, workarounds, and mitigation plans required to restore services.


**Incident Coordination \& Bridge Management**
* Assemble and lead Incident Response Teams (IRT) across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Support functions.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage incident bridge calls, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and progress tracking.
* Remove operational roadblocks and maintain resolution momentum throughout the incident lifecycle.


**Stakeholder \& Customer Communication**
* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communications to customers, leadership teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure communication consistency across customer notifications, management updates, bridge calls, and service status channels.
* Manage communications for high\-impact incidents affecting strategic customers and business\-critical operations.


**Status Page \& Customer Transparency**
* Own customer\-facing status page updates for all major incidents.
* Publish clear incident updates outlining customer impact, affected services, mitigation activities, and recovery progress.
* Maintain defined communication cadence throughout incident management and restoration activities.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across all communication channels.


**RCA \& Problem Management**

* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to eliminate underlying causes.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.


**Monitoring, Governance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Daily Operations Reviews (DORs), providing updates on incident trends, risks, and operational performance.
* Analyze incident patterns and service trends to identify stability improvements and automation opportunities.
* Support enhancements in monitoring, alerting, reporting dashboards, and operational tooling.
* Maintain audit\-ready incident documentation across Zendesk, Jira, RCA repositories, and reporting systems.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during critical incidents when required.
* Ensure accountability, ownership, and adherence to escalation processes across all stakeholder groups.


**Operational Excellence**

* Participate in a 24x7 rotational on\-call support model to provide uninterrupted major incident coverage.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-first service delivery.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Proven experience in Major Incident Management, Service Operations, Production Support, IT Service Management, or Site Reliability Operations.
* Strong experience managing critical P1/P2 incidents in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional technical teams during high\-pressure incident situations.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Experience conducting incident triage, impact assessments, severity classification, and escalation management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and problem management initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based environments, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.

* Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment

* Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment

Accelya is proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to its customers, including through its partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of its Global Product teams.*

 All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Enterprise Change & Insights Manager (Senior Program Manager)-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager (Senior Program Manager)\-1
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to support Mastercard Multi Centre Strategy, in support of a Mastercard business, which provides Critical National Infrastructure to the UK.
   

  

 The Mastercard UK company that enables the payments of 90% of salaries, 70% of utility bills, most ATM transactions and every cheque cleared in the UK.
   

  

 We provide services to over 60 million citizens, and the UK private, public and third sectors.
   

  

 In 2024, we processed 14 billion transactions, with a value of more than £10 trillion.
   

  

 The Mastercard UK companies products include Bacs Direct Credits, Bacs Direct Debits, Faster Payments, the LINK ATM network for cash withdrawals, and the Image Clearing Service (ICS) that supports cheque clearing.
   

  

**Overview**
 This is an exciting opportunity to join Mastercard as an Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager. Working in a SAFe Agile environment, this role plays a key part in enabling and delivering value efficiently and sustainably, with a strong focus on agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and actionable insights.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is curious, motivated, and eager to learn—someone who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about enabling seamless change delivery and insights for colleagues and customers.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager will support the planning, coordination and delivery of enterprise\-wide change initiatives, helping to modernise reporting, and drive a culture of AI enabled automation, continuous improvement and innovation in line with organisational priorities.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on delivery role requiring strong organisational, analytical and communication skills will contribute to initiative planning, requirements development, stakeholder engagement, documentation, reporting and user readiness activities, while applying agile ways of working and continuous improvement practices to support effective business change. A key part of the role is interpreting information from multiple sources, identifying trends, risks and opportunities, and turning analysis into practical, actionable insights that support informed decision\-making.
   

  

**Accountabilities Summary**
* Support the planning, coordination and delivery of change initiatives or workstreams of moderate complexity using agile methodologies.
* A curiosity around AI technology, tools and operating model opportunities
* Analyse delivery data, stakeholder feedback, risks and performance indicators to define early indicator triggers, identify trends, root causes, emerging issues and opportunities to apply AI and automation to streamline workflows and deliver efficiency.
* Translate analysis into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that help stakeholders prioritise activity, make informed decisions and improve delivery outcomes.
* Prepare and maintain change documentation, dashboards, reports, plans and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate reviews, revisions, enhancements, testing, documentation and implementation activities, including user acceptance testing where required.
* Contribute to agile ceremonies, workshops and feedback sessions, promoting continuous improvement and collaborative problem\-solving.
* Support agile methodology compliance, identify barriers to successful delivery, and coordinate resolution or escalation of issues as appropriate.
* Provide input into business processes, standards, plans and service improvements to support effective delivery and sustainable change outcomes.


**Experience And Skills Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in change management frameworks or large scale/complex transformation programs.
* in agile change management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify risks, issues, dependencies, trends and practical resolution options.
* Strong background in data visualisation (e.g., Power BI), analytical insight generation, and data driven reporting
* Ability to convert data, delivery information and stakeholder feedback into concise, evidence\-based insights, recommendations and actions for different audiences.
* Experience developing business and functional requirements, supporting design and testing activities, and working with technology or delivery teams through the delivery lifecycle.
* Strong planning, organisational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.
* Effective interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships across business, technology and delivery teams.
* Foundational understanding of agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban, with enthusiasm for applying agile principles to change delivery.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and collaboration tools; exposure to Jira, MS365 or similar platforms would be beneficial.
* Self\-starter who is curious, proactive, adaptable and comfortable working with minimal supervision in a dynamic environment.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
