title: Program Manager - IFS Loops
description:
IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.
   

  





 At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.
   

  





 We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.
   

  





 By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
 **global, diverse environment;** 
 you will be joining a
 **winning team** 
 with a
 **commitment to sustainability;**
 and a company where we get things done so that you can
 **make a positive impact** 
 on the world.
   

  





 We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
 **\#MakeYourMoment** 
 so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
   

  





 If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 IFS Loops is revolutionizing how leaders and teams work with our agentic platform, driving
   

  

 unprecedented efficiency and scale. We’re establishing a new Program Management team and
   

  

 are looking for a Program Manager to join us in India, working with EST and UK time zones. This
   

  

 role is crucial for managing and delivering complex, high\-impact projects for our largest
   

  

 enterprise customers. You will work closely with clients, internal teams, and senior leadership to
   

  

 ensure successful project execution and long\-term business value.
   

  





**Key Responsibility**




 As a Program Manager, you will be a key member of a newly formed team, responsible for
   

  

 delivering our most high\-profile customer engagements. This means you’ll be:
   

  





  

  




* Program Management: Leading and managing multiple enterprise\-level projects from initiation through delivery, optimization, and tuning.
* You’ll ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget, adhering to our Services Methodology approach.
* Customer Engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leaders and project managers.
* You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for project\-related activities and help educate clients on the nuances of AI and AI assistants.
* **Workshop Ownership and Execution** 
 : Taking ownership of developing workshops to support the creation of user stories and technical requirements for our customers’ AI assistants.
* **Operations** 
 : Managing dependencies and resources, initiating change orders, and documenting all key decisions and meeting outcomes. You’ll also support the sales process as needed to instill customer confidence.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : Coordinating services team members—including solution architects, implementation specialists, and integration engineers—to ensure cohesive project execution. You’ll also collaborate with product, customer success, and sales teams.
* **Risk Management** 
 : Identifying potential project risks and proactively developing mitigation strategies. You’ll serve as the primary escalation point for issues that could jeopardize customer satisfaction or project completion.
* **Steering Committee Ownership** 
 : Providing regular project updates to key senior stakeholders at both TheLoops and the customer’s organization
* **Performance Monitoring** 
 : Tracking project performance in real time, analyzing key metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams. metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams.
* **Continuous Improvement** 
 : Implementing best practices and lessons learned to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of project delivery and advancing operational prowess through collaboration with Services leadership.
* **Customer Success** 
 : Working closely with Sales and Customer Success to ensure a seamless handover and continued client satisfaction post\-implementation, as well as executing follow\-on projects to grow customer value


**Qualifications**
* You have 7\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a focus on enterprise clients within the technology or SaaS industry.
* You have a strong understanding of AI technologies, particularly in deploying conversational AI and automation solutions for large enterprises.
* You can communicate the nuances of AI to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You have a deep understanding of consumer customer service best practices and strategies.
* You are technically adept and comfortable with APIs, data migration, and configuring complex software integrations.
* You’re passionate about AI and possess a working understanding of concepts like LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, and vector databases.
* You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field; a PMP or similar certification is highly desirable.
* You have proven experience building project delivery methodologies and processes.
* You’re a natural leader with excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* You’re willing to travel up to 20% of the time



**What Success Looks Like in 3–6 Months**




  

  

 Within your first 3\-6 months, you will have successfully demonstrated your impact by:
   

  





  

  




* **Becoming an Expert** 
 : You’ll be proficient with TheLoops’s platform and will have a deep understanding of the common challenges our customers face.
* **Leading Implementations** 
 : You will have autonomously managed and completed at least one high\-stakes customer implementation from start to finish. This includes leading discovery, architecting the solution, configuring the platform, and successfully migrating data.
* **Driving Customer Value** 
 : You will have received positive feedback from customers, validating that you’ve not only met their technical requirements but have also empowered their teams and improved their operational efficiency.
* **Strengthening Team Collaboration** 
 : You will have established strong working relationships with the sales, engineering, and product teams, providing valuable feedback from the field to help improve our product and processes.



 Why Join Us
   

  




* Work on cutting\-edge AI solutions that have real business impact
* Be part of a fast\-growing team shaping how enterprises deploy AI at scale
* High ownership, high visibility, and a chance to lead transformational projects
* Competitive compensation, flexible work, and the support of a global enterprise (IFS)


**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Procurement Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.
   

  

 Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
* Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross\-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
* Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
* Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
* Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
* Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
* Manage cross\-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
* Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision\-making.
* Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
* Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional team environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
* Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**RFP Delivery Manager** 




  





**AArete is one\-of\-a\-kind when it comes to consulting firm culture.** 









 We’re a global, innovative management and technology consulting firm with offices in the U.S. and India. Our name comes from the Greek word for excellence: “Areté.” And excellence is exactly what we strive for.

 AAretians (our team members) are leaders at every level. You are encouraged to unlock your full potential by directly contributing to our mission and prioritizing personal development and fulfillment.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The RFP Delivery Manager owns execution of AART’s RFP portfolio while serving as a strategic and writing partner to the Vice President. This role is accountable for end\-to\-end delivery, content quality, and day\-to\-day decision\-making across all pursuits.
 



 The role combines delivery leadership, healthcare and business acumen, writing ownership, and effective use of AI in the proposal process. It is not a coordination\-only role.
 



  





**Work You’ll Do** 




**RFP Delivery Ownership** 



* Lead RFPs from intake through submission
* Own schedules, compliance tracking, review cycles, and final quality control
* Act as the default decision\-maker on delivery\-related issues when the VP is unavailable



**Strategic Interpretation and Support** 



* Apply strong healthcare and general business acumen to interpret guidance from Managing Directors and senior SMEs
* Translate high\-level or ambiguous input into clear proposal positioning, structure, and direction
* Proactively identify strategy gaps, inconsistencies, or risks and elevate recommendations early



**Writing and Content Ownership** 



* Take direct writing ownership for proposal sections as needed, including executive summaries, approaches, and strategy\-heavy responses
* Edit and finalize content to ensure clarity, concision, and executive\-level quality
* Ensure consistency with AArete’s voice, POV, win themes, and differentiators



**AI\-Enabled Proposal Execution** 



* Use AI tools effectively to improve proposal speed, quality, and consistency
* Apply AI to accelerate drafting, synthesize SME input and prior material, and support compliance and redundancy checks
* Establish clear guardrails to ensure AI output is refined, validated, and elevated AArete’s natural, direct, non\-fluff voice
* Coach proposal team members on practical, responsible use of AI in proposal development



**Quality and Risk Management** 



* Enforce standards for clarity, consistency, and non\-redundancy across all submissions
* Identify and manage risks related to scope, resourcing, compliance, or narrative quality
* Resolve issues directly where possible; escalate selectively and with options



**Key Characteristics of this Role** 



* Combines execution ownership with strategic judgement
* Requires substantive writing and editing responsibility
* Acts as an operational deputy to the VP
* Uses AI for speed, efficiency, and effectiveness
* Other duties as assigned



  





**Requirements** 



* 12\+ Years of experience in proposal management, RFP leadership, business development, and executive communications

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge (preferred but not absolutely required) and solid business acumen
* Experience leading complex RFPs with senior stakeholders
* Executive\-level writing and editing capability
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize ambiguous input into clear and differentiating responses
* Practical experience using AI in proposal development



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexible Paid Time Off of up to 23 days annually, in addition to 10 paid public holidays
* Hybrid work model with flexible in\-office attendance
* Comprehensive health benefits including medical insurance (Mediclaim), personal accident insurance, and term life insurance
* Generous paid parental leave program
* Attractive employee referral bonus scheme
* Transportation allowance and night shift allowance
* Employee advance salary loan facility
* Structured professional certification reimbursement policy to support ongoing learning and development



  





**We put humans at the center of our work** 




  





 We’re a global management and technology consulting firm specializing in strategic profitability improvement, digital transformation, and strategy \& change for clients. Our cross\-industry solutions are powered by a digital\-first mindset, market intelligence, and data\-driven approach to deliver purposeful change, actionable insights, and guaranteed results.
 



  





 But what sets us apart is our people. We are guided by our deeply embedded guiding principles: Excellence, Passion, Loyalty to Clients, Stewardship, Family, Community, Sustainability, and Inclusion.

description:
**Lattice Overview**
 There is energy here…energy you can feel crackling at any of our international locations. It’s an energy generated by enthusiasm for our work, for our teams, for our results, and for our customers. Lattice is a worldwide community of engineers, designers, and manufacturing operations specialists in partnership with world\-class sales, marketing, and support teams, who are developing programmable logic solutions that are changing the industry. Our focus is on R\&D, product innovation, and customer service, and to that focus, we bring total commitment and a keenly sharp competitive personality.
   

  

 Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results\-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a “team first” organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you’re looking for.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 The organization is seeking an experienced Staff\-level EDA / Software Operations Specialist to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of both EDA and enterprise software vendor engagements. This role serves as the primary liaison between engineering, procurement, finance, and legal functions to ensure that all vendor contracts, renewals, and purchase transactions are executed in a timely, compliant, and cost\-effective manner. Given the scale and complexity of the vendor portfolio, the role requires strong project management discipline to track hundreds of concurrent threads across contracts, approvals, and stakeholders, along with excellent communication skills to coordinate effectively across cross\-functional and often global teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the complete lifecycle of EDA and Software vendor contracts, including new agreements, renewals, extensions, and terminations, across multiple vendors and tool categories.
* Track license utilization, renewal timelines, and contract expiry dates across a large and diverse vendor portfolio, proactively initiating renewal discussions to avoid business disruption.
* Raise and manage Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) for EDA tools, software licenses, and related services, ensuring accuracy of commercial terms, quantities, and cost centers.
* Partner with Finance teams to obtain budget approvals, validate cost allocations, and ensure alignment with departmental and organizational budgets.
* Coordinate with Legal teams to route vendor contracts, Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and amendments through the appropriate review and clearance process.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, and licensing models with EDA and Software vendors in collaboration with sourcing/procurement stakeholders, where applicable.
* Apply strong project management practices to simultaneously track hundreds of active threads, spanning contract negotiations, approval workflows, renewal deadlines, and stakeholder follow\-ups, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Maintain accurate, well\-organized, and up\-to\-date records of all vendor contracts, license entitlements, renewal schedules, and approval documentation.
* Serve as the key point of contact for internal engineering, IT, and design teams regarding EDA and software license availability, tool access issues, and procurement status.
* Communicate proactively and clearly with stakeholders across Engineering, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and vendor\-side teams, providing regular status updates and escalating risks or delays in a timely manner.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring proper documentation, license compliance, and adherence to organizational procurement policies.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization, license right\-sizing, and consolidation across EDA and software vendor contracts.
* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards on vendor spend, renewal pipeline, and vendor performance for management review.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders across geographies, given the global nature of EDA and software vendor relationships.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of relevant experience in EDA Operations, Software Asset Management, IT Procurement, or a similar vendor/contract management function within a semiconductor or technology organization.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with EDA vendors and familiarity with common EDA licensing models (node\-locked, floating, term\-based licenses), as well as experience managing enterprise software vendor contracts.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, including purchase requisition and purchase order workflows within enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa, or similar).
* Working knowledge of contract lifecycle management, including experience coordinating with Legal teams on contract review and clearance.
* Experience partnering with Finance functions on budgeting, cost tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
* Strong project management skills, with proven ability to track and manage a high volume (hundreds) of parallel threads, deadlines, and stakeholder actions without losing accuracy or momentum.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly convey status, risks, and priorities to diverse stakeholders including senior management, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation practices.
* Ability to manage multiple vendor renewals and deadlines simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus but not mandatory.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience specifically in a semiconductor design company or design services organization.
* Familiarity with license management tools (e.g., FlexLM/FlexNet) and license usage monitoring practices.
* Familiarity with project/task tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar) to manage high\-volume workstreams.
* Exposure to global vendor contract negotiations across multiple regions.
* Formal project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is an added advantage.


**Additional Information**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

title: Associate Consultant, Omnium Services (Multiple Roles)
description:

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Role**
 The job involves working as SME in a team for a Global Derivatives Process, specializing in administering end to end life cycle of the derivative instruments. The position requires good experience and back ground in financial markets and derivatives product.
   

  

 Knowledge \& Skills
   

  

**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills**
* Good working knowledge of Derivatives Products.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.
* A good team player – ability to work and adapt to large teams
* Excellent interpersonal skills for liaising with related departments, brokers and IM’s.
* Should be capable of understanding various control checks.
* Sound knowledge of the financial markets, instruments and back office functions.


**Responsibilities**
 The responsibilities may include, but may not be limited to, the following;
   

  

* Act as a subject matter expertise for the process: allocation and manage the volume assigned, assists others (troubleshooting ) to complete their work in time. Ensure allocated partners are well aware with the Process Timelines, Escalation Protocol and display sense of urgency when dealing with critical queries.
* Zero tolerance to errors and deviations from established procedures in performing tasks (including review and approvals) in respect of assigned partners to achieve 100% process quality and accuracy
* Thorough understanding of overall business model and impact of various sub processes on the business.Produce timely and accurate management reporting, EOD reports etc.
* Demonstrate awareness of team’s activities and actions may potentially be damaging to the Northern Trust business, its clients, and/or financial markets
* Ensure Process Documentation (DPADs, Checklists, Process Maps, etc.) is up to date and is in line with EO standards.
* Perform Operational control review for assigned areas: review of processes migrated in recent past, compliance to CASS rules, aged break management, BCP stress test etc
* Being an SME, strives to enhance processes and procedures and work towards improving quality and efficiency. Continuous improvement, in regard to organizational quality and performance, focuses on improving client satisfaction through continuous and incremental improvements to processes, including by removing unnecessary activities and variations.
* Deploy relevant training to staff around 'Quality' and encourage them to explore opportunities for improvement
* Identify Process improvement and automation opportunities. Assist and monitor team projects till logical conclusion
* Focus on identifying and meeting Client needs in the most effective way. Bespoke or any deviation in the current procedure should not be introduced in the process unless the Client Impact, Downstream impacts are ascertained and mitigated
* Understand in detail the types of process specifications/ quirks that exist in the process and demonstrate the same. Understand what these specifications/ quirks mean from a service/business perspective and the potential implications on an internal and/or external client. Ensure processes remain ‘fit for purpose’ and continue to effectively support both existing and new clients, IM’s, Brokers, Products and Services.
* Take full ownership of allocated sub process/project and ensure all road blocks are cleared/escalated to ensure no impact to client delivery
* Lead planning and execution of the project/program including coordination with the relevant stakeholders. Apply knowledge of function\-wide and operation specific policies and procedures that support assigned goals and objectives of the project


**Minimum Qualifications (Education, Experience)**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related field
* Work experience in financial industry: 4 years minimum.
* Managing multiple stakeholders in Bangalore, Chicago and Melbourne would be the key expectation from candidate, hence prior exposure would be given a preference
* This role is for NA shift and candidate should be flexible to work in NA shift for foreseeable future.
* Candidate should be flexible to work in Pune as a work location.
* Extensive knowledge and experience of derivatives products is required. Experience in Exchange traded Derivatives is desired
* Strong problem solving skills, detail and results oriented.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint presentations.
* Excellent spoken and written English and the ability to handle business correspondence.
* Sound knowledge of the financial markets, instruments and back office functions.
* Demonstrate high ethical standards.
* Proactive and capable to handle multiple tasks under extremely time sensitive conditions.
* Good understanding of trade economics related to various financial product transactions is an addition.
* Candidate should be willing to work in a 24\*5 environment


**Eligibility \- Internal Partners**
* 24 Months as a Senior Analyst to move as an Associate Consultant

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Program Manager
description:
**Role Title:** 
**Program Manager / Sr. Program Manager**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India (Primary site leadership responsibility); relocation provided if need
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Executive Leadership \- Managing Director India Operations
   

  

**About This Role**
 Veradigm India has a lot of transformation underway. AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development and culture building programs \- each with its own stakeholders, timelines, and interdependencies. What we need is someone who can hold all of that together.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue across Veradigm India's most important initiatives. You will partner with the key stakeholders, keep the assigned programs on track, surface risks before they become problems, and make sure the MD India has an accurate picture of where things stand.
   

  

 This role carries real strategic weight. You will be the person who ensures that Veradigm India's most important transformation programs do not just get started \- they get finished, on time, to the standard we set, with measurable outcomes. You will need to read situations accurately to inform and influence senior stakeholders. The right person for this role has key awareness of organizational culture, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, persistent, and politically aware \- someone who brings structure to complexity and credibility to every room they walk into.
   

  

 In essence, this role will drive execution of one or more major programs (strategic project or a group of strategically aligned projects), ensuring that commitments are delivered on time, within scope, to budget, and to the required quality standards. Operating at the most senior level with customers and/or internal stakeholders; managing business changes and implementing business strategies to meet the goals and objectives of the organization and our clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with HRBP and Culture leads to program\-manage Veradigm India’s associate culture building programs \- including culture and fun initiatives, sports and wellness, communication skill\-building, and other engagement initiatives \- owning the program plan, tracking milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, and reporting outcomes to MD India.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to program\-manage Veradigm India’s CSR and sustainability commitments \- ensuring initiatives are scoped, funded, tracked, and delivered with the same rigor as internal transformation programs, and that impact is documented and visible to leadership and the broader organization.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to program\-manage the campus hiring program \- maintaining the calendar, coordinating between TA and business leaders, monitoring execution quality, and flagging risks before they slip.
* Partner with the India Leadership Team to coordinate cross\-functional transformation workstreams \- capability building, operational improvement, and strategic initiatives \- take on program management of the execution\-heavy workstreams, bringing structure, tracking, and stakeholder coordination from kickoff through delivery \- ensuring each has a clear plan, an active owner, and is on track to deliver.
* Maintain a single, reliable view of all India transformation programs \- milestones, risks, decisions, and open items \- that executive leadership can trust at any point in time.
* Facilitate governance forums and working sessions that are purposeful: right people in the room, decisions made, actions assigned and followed through.
* Define and document program scope, objectives, and success metrics at program launch. Manage scope changes and escalate impact on timelines or deliverables as needed.
* Prepare crisp, decision\-ready program updates for executive leadership \- calibrated to what the audience needs to act, not just status summaries.
* Identify and escalate risks early, with context and a proposed path forward. Drive continuous improvement in how programs are planned and executed across India Operations.


**Success Metrics**
 Within 12 months, this Program Manager will be expected to demonstrate:
   

  

* Programs delivered on time and within scope \- with milestones tracked, risks surfaced early, and no surprises to leadership.
* All three workstreams (AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development \& culture building programs) have active plans, clear owners, and status visible to MD India at any time.
* Governance cadence in place at a program level \- working sessions are purposeful, decisions are logged, and actions are followed through within agreed timelines.
* Stakeholder partners (HRBP, TA, ILT, Operations and Transformation) report that coordination is adding value \- reducing friction, not creating it.
* Executive updates and program communications are consistently clear, accurate, and decision\-ready \- not followed up for clarification.
* Risks and issues are raised proactively, with a recommended path forward \- not surfaced after they have already become problems.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
**Experience**
* 3\+ years of cross\-functional program management work experience
* Experience in healthcare, health tech, SaaS, IT services, or regulated industries strongly preferred
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2 or similar project management certification will be added advantage


**Key Skills And Leadership Traits**
* Can hold ten things at once and not drop any of them. Multi\-program coordination is the core of this role.
* Knows how to build a clean workplan, run a useful governance meeting, and write a crisp executive update \- without being asked twice for any of them.
* Metrics driven – drives measurable and outcomes driven processes
* Good at working with people, not around them. Your job is to help partners succeed, not to take their work over.
* Communicate at the right level for the right audience. Your executive update is sharp and to the point. Your working session with a team lead is detailed and collaborative.
* Can hold stakeholders accountable. You know how to follow up without making people feel managed.
* Well versed how to use LLM tools including Claude and is capability of augmenting work with AI .
* Proficient in MS Office \- PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams in particular


**Education**
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline is a plus \- but not required if the experience demonstrates the right thinking
* Tier\-I institute will be preferred (results matter more than resumes)


**Our Values**
 We talk about values a lot at Veradigm. But we mean them as operating principles, not wall art. Here is what they look like in practice.
   

  

* Better Starts with Different: The best thinking at Veradigm has always come from people who see things differently. We are not looking for conformity. We are looking for perspective.
* Unreasonably High Standards: We set the bar high \- not because we enjoy pressure, but because the work we do affects real patients and real clinicians. That matters.
* Outcomes that Matter: We are not here to be busy. We are here to move things. If the work is not making a real difference, we ask why and we change it.
* Make Decisions and Own Them: We do not hide behind process or wait for permission. We make the call, we own what happens next, and we correct course when we need to.
* No Silos, No Handoffs: When something needs to get done at Veradigm, the right answer is never 'that is not my team.' We stay in the conversation until it is resolved.


**Benefits**
 Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
   

  

* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days
* Flexible Work Environment (Hybrid)
* Peer\-based incentive “Cheer” awards
* Tuition Reimbursement Program


 To know more about the benefits and culture at Veradigm, please visit the links mentioned below: \-
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/benefits/
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/culture/
   

  

 Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Data Conversion Project Manager (Pune)
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Historical Data Conversion Project Manager, you will serve as the essential link between our technical Data Solution Consultants (DSCs) and the client’s business stakeholders. While DSCs focus on the technical execution of data migration and complex analysis, your role is to translate that work into a clear narrative for the client while relaying client requirements back to the internal team. You will leverage a strong understanding of HDC processes, investment data, and technical frameworks to comfortably bridge the gap between technical execution and client expectations. By working side\-by\-side with the DSCs to identify data remediation strategies, you will translate technical requirements into actionable directives for the client and proactively secure necessary inputs. This role is for a subject matter expert who can navigate technical language and investment complexities to drive project progress and maintain high\-impact communication regarding status, gaps, and timelines.
   

  

 You’ll also be among the first members of the Data Solutions team based in India, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with Data Solutions: Serve as the dedicated partner to the internal Data Solutions Consultants, ensuring they have clear specifications and context while managing administrative workflows to allow them to focus on technical execution.
* Translate Technical Progress: Translate technical progress, data challenges, and migration results provided by the Data Solutions team into digestible business narratives for client stakeholders.
* Lead Client Status Calls: Lead regular status calls with clients to convey project health, presenting successful data loads and managing expectations around timelines or data discrepancies.
* Facilitate Information Flow: Facilitate the flow of information between parties, ensuring client requirements are accurately scoped for the technical team and technical constraints are clearly explained to the client.
* Oversee Portfolio of Projects: Prioritize and context\-switch effectively to oversee simultaneous projects, maintaining close alignment with the Data Solutions team on resource availability.
* Drive Process Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities to improve the communication workflow between the Project Management and Data Solutions functions.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: Minimum 2\+ years of experience in project management, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of managing client relationships and communicating complex project updates.
* Client\-Focused: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and manage "difficult conversations" regarding timelines or scope.
* Investment\-Savvy: Strong understanding of financial products and securities modeling (technical implementation skills not required, but conceptual understanding is key).
* Solutions\-Oriented: Creative problem\-solver who operates with ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact, specifically in bridging the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Process\-Minded: Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale.
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders.
* Technical (Bonus): Familiarity with Python or SQL. While you won’t be building the infrastructure, your ability to query data or understand automated workflows will help you scale your impact and communicate more effectively.


**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: AI Project Manager, Loop Engineer
description:
**Role Description** 




 A NEW KIND OF PROJECT MANAGER
 



 BetaCraft builds software with a small human team and a fleet of AI coding agents. The agents write most of the code. What they cannot do is the thing this role is for: take a half\-formed sentence from a domain expert, turn it into something buildable, get it built, prove it works, and make sure the same mistake never needs fixing twice.
 



 We call that loop engineering. A loop is: a stakeholder says something → it becomes a plan in plain language → a human approves it → agents build it in isolation → a gate checks it against evidence → a pull request opens → the stakeholder sees it working → and whatever was learned becomes a rule the next loop inherits. Loop engineering is designing that so a human touches it only where judgment matters, and it keeps closing when you walk away.
 



 We are hiring two to three senior people to own loops end to end. You will not groom a board or write a weekly deck. You will sit in the middle of a domain expert, a client's engineering lead, a second developer, an internal control plane, and six to eight parallel AI build lanes — and you will be the reason all of it converges.
 



  





 THE BASICS
 



 In\-office role, based in Pune.
 



 Full\-time, Senior
 



 .
 



 STAKEHOLDER\-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT, AS WE PRACTISE IT
 



 — The stakeholder's words are the spec. Old documents are history, never authority. The hierarchy is: built code, then the client's primary sources, then our own specs.
 



 — Every request becomes a tracked story in our system. Every story gets a plan a non\-technical person can approve. Approval is the only merge signal.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. We measure success by how often an approved story ships correctly with zero human touches after approval, and we always show that number beside its guard: how much came back within a week.
 



 — "Done" is a claim. Evidence is a real\-environment walk, a screenshot, a number traced to its source, green CI on the final commit. You reject the rest, politely, every time.
 



  





 HUMANS ARE THE BOTTLENECK. WE DESIGN AROUND IT.
 



 Agents build in minutes. Humans answer in hours, or the next morning, or after the weekend. Every loop we run is shaped by that one fact, and this role owns the shape.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. The plan is argued before approval, so nothing waits on a human after it.
 



 — Park and continue. When a loop hits a question only a human can answer, it parks that item with a default and keeps moving. Nothing blocks on a ruling.
 



 — Decide the rest yourself. Only the genuine 50\-50 calls reach the expert. Everything else you decide, record, and stand behind.
 



 — Primaries before people. A question goes to the expert only after you have proven the answer is not already in a primary source, an earlier ruling, or an old email. Then you batch, ask once, and store once.
 



 — The nightly loop runs alone and reports only. A regression walk runs every night; humans read one morning report and rule on the few parked items. That report is your control surface.
 



 — Two pipeline tiers. Small changes take the fast path; money, schema and cross\-surface changes take the full path. You pick the tier, and a human sees it only when urgency and tier conflict.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO
 



 — Sit with the domain expert. Hear a rule, restate it as a testable build order, ask "does that make sense?", and write it down where the next loop will find it.
 



 — Decide what to ask and what to build. If a primary source answers the question, you do not ask the expert. If you must ask, you batch, you ask once, and you store the answer once. The expert is never the bottleneck.
 



 — Design loops. Intake, plan, approve, build, gate, verify, record. You pick the pipeline tier per change, you write the impact brief before dispatch (what else this touches, what could break, who must say go), and you decide when a human is needed and when they are not.
 



 — Build harnesses. When something slips, you do not just fix it. You build the guard: a deterministic check, a parity test, a regression walk that runs every night and reports only, a morning report that is your control surface. Sweeps discover; guards lock. Every rule carries the incident that paid for it.
 



 — Run the agent fleet. Know when a lane is stale, when to kill it, when context is the bottleneck, when to say "don't build, just answer". Escalate only the genuine 50\-50 calls; decide the rest yourself.
 



 — Hold the boundaries. The client's engineers own their code; you flag, you never touch. A second developer's work is gated before it merges. Merges are sequenced with an order and a parallel\-safety note, never a bare list.
 



 — Communicate like a colleague. Firm, factual, collaborative, no blame. Every number you send is backed by a ledger you keep.
 



  





 WHO DOES WELL HERE
 



 — Problem\-solving is your reflex, not a skill you list. You reduce a messy report to the actual failing mechanism before anyone touches it.
 



 — You read fast and completely. A long regulatory guide, a two\-hundred\-row issue log and a forty\-file diff in one morning, holding the contradictions between them in your head.
 



 — You can read a code diff. You do not need to write code. You do need to notice that a fix landed in the wrong layer and ask why.
 



 — You see every bug as a class, and you also know when a class\-wide sweep is too risky to run mid\-acceptance.
 



 — You have product taste. You know a random banner when you see one, and you think about context before you delete an info icon.
 



 — You are calm under a date that does not move, and you would rather build the guard tonight than explain the same miss tomorrow.
 



  





 STRONG SIGNAL
 



 — You have been the single point of contact between a domain expert and an engineering team, and things shipped.
 



 — You have run or supervised AI coding agents on real work and have opinions about where they fail.
 



 — You have written a process rule after an incident that a team still follows.
 



 — Delivery in a domain where a wrong number costs money: tax, payments, insurance, compliance, analytics.
 



  





 NOT REQUIRED
 



 — Writing production code.
 



 — Prior knowledge of any specific domain. You learn each one from its primary sources.
 



 You will struggle here if your instinct on a hard question is "I'll check with the team", if you count tickets moved rather than proofs produced, or if telling a senior engineer that a green build is not evidence makes you uncomfortable.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 Proven experience managing complex engineering or software implementation projects, in technology\-driven environments.
 



  





 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field.
 



  





 HOW WE HIRE
 



 Work samples only. No behavioural interviews. About five hours over two weeks.
 


1. Design the loop (take\-home, 90 min): a stakeholder scenario with an expert, a client engineer and an agent fleet. Draw the loop, name where a human must touch it, and name the first three guards you would build.
2. The "done" report (live, 45 min): an agent's confident pull request with passing tests. Say what evidence you would demand and what you would say to the agent.
3. The expert relay (live, 45 min): a call transcript. Sort every item into build now, ask first, already answered, out of scope. Draft the one message you send back.
4. Incident to guard (live, 30 min): a real post\-mortem. Write the rule, then the mechanical check that enforces it.
5. Conversation with Leadership Team (60 min): we show you our own process review, cons included, and ask where you think we are wrong.



  





 Apply with a short note and one thing you wrote that other people still use: a process rule, a post\-mortem, a decision log, a runbook.
 



  





 To be considered for this opportunity, please complete our short application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3Kp0vjf\-8TpgC3SCctw1p4MMO2HZMEgVUcZTxYpwZnyNOvg/viewform

title: SAP Implementation Lead - India
description:
Our client, a leading global healthcare and consulting organization, is seeking an experienced
 **SAP Implementation Lead** 
 to drive the successful delivery of large\-scale SAP transformation initiatives across global business functions. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in end\-to\-end SAP implementation delivery, S/4HANA transformation programs, stakeholder management, deployment governance, and cross\-functional execution within complex enterprise environments. This role will act as the primary bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring successful solution design, implementation execution, business readiness, and transition into steady\-state operations while maintaining alignment with program objectives and global standards.
   





 This is a contractual role through the end of 2026, with a strong likelihood of extension well into 2027\. Candidates must be able to commute to the Client’s on\-site Pune, India office.
   




 Responsibilities
   

* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementation activities across planning, design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support phases
* Drive SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives ensuring delivery within scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations
* Partner with business leaders, functional teams, System Integrators, and technical stakeholders to define implementation roadmaps and execution strategy
* Translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and industry best practices
* Own implementation governance, status reporting, risk management, and executive stakeholder communication
* Facilitate workshops, solution design sessions, decision\-making forums, and architecture discussions across business and technology teams
* Coordinate deployment planning, environment readiness, cutover activities, and transition into hypercare and stabilization phases
* Ensure seamless integration across SAP modules and connected enterprise systems
* Support business readiness activities including process alignment, change management, training coordination, and user adoption initiatives
* Oversee testing strategy and execution including SIT, UAT, defect management, and release readiness
* Establish delivery controls across project milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and implementation quality assurance
* Drive data migration coordination and support governance around system readiness and operational continuity
* Provide leadership and mentoring across implementation teams while promoting delivery excellence and continuous improvement
* Act as the escalation point for implementation risks, blockers, and critical decisions throughout the project lifecycle
* Partner closely with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to support the ECC to SAP S/4HANA upgrade and ensure alignment with financial transformation objectives
* Lead finance\-related workstreams including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets, and Financial Reporting processes during the S/4HANA implementation
* Ensure financial controls, accounting policies, period\-close processes, and reporting requirements are appropriately designed and transitioned into the S/4HANA environment
* Support finance process harmonization, chart of accounts alignment, and integration between SAP Finance (FI/CO) and operational modules as part of the enterprise transformation program


 Requirements
   

* 10\+ years of experience delivering SAP implementation and transformation programs
* Proven experience leading at least 2–3 full lifecycle SAP implementations, preferably SAP S/4HANA
* Strong understanding of SAP implementation methodologies (SAP Activate, Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid delivery models)
* Experience managing global deployments and enterprise\-scale transformation initiatives
* Strong expertise across business process design, solution deployment, and operational readiness
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams including Business, IT, Data, Testing, Change, and Integration workstreams
* Hands\-on understanding of SAP functional landscapes and integration across enterprise applications
* Experience supporting cutover planning, hypercare, stabilization, and transition management
* Familiarity with testing governance, defect management, and release execution processes
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills
* Consulting experience within Healthcare, Pharma, Life Sciences, or regulated environments preferred
* Strong accounting and finance background with experience working closely with CFO organizations and finance stakeholders
* Experience supporting ECC to SAP S/4HANA system upgrades with significant Finance (FI/CO) transformation components

* Practical experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot or equivalent) to support project management tasks; ability to identify and apply AI use cases that improve PM and RTE efficiency and ways of working.
* Understanding of Product Life Cycle Management (prior experience as developer, tester, architect, or requirements manager is an advantage).
* Ability to bring structure to ambiguous environments; influence change outside span of control.
* Strong and concise verbal and written communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Self\-starter, adaptable, customer\-oriented; able to work across cross\-functional business and technical teams.

* SAFe Agilist, SAFe Scrum Master, or SAFe Release Train Engineer — strongly preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent PM certification — strongly preferred.

title: Project Manager 2 - C13 - PUNE
description:
Citi’s Markets Operations has embarked on a significant, multi\-year transformation journey to design and deliver a future state Target operating Model covering risk and controls, regulatory compliance, process engineering, automation, people and culture, data transformation, technology investment and client service. We are passionate about our people and our culture and are invested in creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 We are currently recruiting a candidate to join a cross functional global team within the Markets Operations Process Engineering team. The Process Engineering team was formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank to deliver this multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment, change execution and a market\-leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process engineering and low code application development.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 The Vice President Project Manager/Business Analyst role we are recruiting for will be instrumental in supporting Change initiatives in one or more projects for Markets Operations. The role will combine project management expertise and analytical skills to support transformation in partnership with operations teams and technology partners globally across Citi. The role requires a good understanding of Markets products and operational processing as well as project management practices and discipline.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage a set of assigned projects; Developing plans, tracking progress of deliverables, performing analysis, ensuring all project delivery documentation is in place to the required standard and meeting stakeholder expectations
* Work with stakeholders to ensure program scope definition meets Operations objective, ensuring requirements are strategic, clearly documented, well understood by all stakeholders including Technology and backed by a business case, cost benefit analysis, tangible benefits and associated KPIs
* Proactively manage the communication of status, issue, resolution and risks to the Sponsor and key stakeholders on a timely basis, and engaged in/driving working groups, senior forums, and workshops where required
* Foster and maintain relationships with business and technology stakeholders acting as SME to senior stakeholders and/or other team members
* Implement best practices and global consistency, simplifying \& standardizing processes, controls and flows.
* Lead identification, and drive resolution of issues, including those outside of the immediate workstream within their remit
* Support stakeholders across a program lifecycle such as testing and operational readiness planning
* Facilitate and deliver change to reduce the risk profile
* Drives adherence to program processes, procedures, methods, and standards for program delivery as defined by Citi PM standards
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency


**What we’ll need from you:**
* Significant experience in delivering transformation programs in a fast paced, large global financial services firm, ideally in an operations, risk or technology organization
* Exceptional Program Management skills; Specialized program management and/or reengineering certifications (six sigma, Agile, Lean, Prince 2 or PMP).
* Strong organization and multi\-tasking skills. Flexibility to handle multiple tasks and changing priorities along with a desire to work in a dynamic environment is key.
* Excellent analytical, data management and problem\-solving skills and ability to clearly document findings and proposals for solutions using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, JIRA, Confluence and any other relevant tools.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. A demonstrated ability to effectively communicate technical and business issues and solutions to multiple levels
* Exercise independence of judgement/autonomy and can operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Experience with stakeholder engagement with the ability to lead and drive working groups with senior stakeholders.


**Qualifications:**
* Relevant years of PM experience and prior industry experience
* Fully knowledgeable on the day\-to\-day activities of a product or process; Basic understanding of the firm's different businesses and the related economics; Individual is expected to be subject area expert in one (or more) specific skill sets
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of how own area and others collectively integrate to contribute towards achieving business objectives


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred
